settings.title: What Our Conference Permit Service Covers

settings.editor: We manage the key steps in your conference permit application, from classification and document preparation to submission and follow-up.
We review your conference plans, including format, activities and organizing entity, to identify the applicable category and eligibility requirements.
We help coordinate the organizer details, programme, speaker information, venue and supporting documents needed for the application.
We support the submission process and keep the information consistent. The authority reviews the application and issues its decision.
We help coordinate responses to additional information requests, application corrections and supporting documents during review.
If the dates, venue or event scope change, we review the update and help coordinate the relevant amendment or cancellation steps.
Government fees and published service time are subject to the applicable category. Preparation and additional review may take longer.

items.item_title: 01  Does a one-day conference need a permit?
06  What if our conference details change?

settings.editor: The permit route depends on the conference category and activities, not only its duration. We review the event brief to identify the applicable requirements.
The organizing entity’s eligibility and the application route depend on the relevant category. We help review those details and the supporting information.
Start with organizer details, the programme, speakers, proposed venue, attendance and dates, plus any sponsors or accompanying activities.
Include all sponsor booths, exhibitions and accompanying activities in the brief so their requirements can be considered in the application review.
We can coordinate event information and relevant guest arrangements, including visa application support where applicable. Entry and permit decisions remain with the authorities.
Tell us when dates, venue, programme or activities change. We review the update and help coordinate the relevant correction, amendment or cancellation steps.
Share a few details and our team will discuss the next steps with you.
